kind.detail: BUG-2787 at c8a4fbf642a1 (1 commit behind main; findings do not depend on base changes). The fast-gates job is also red, and its gate could not be identified from the sandbox. Two non-blocking follow-ups: lane_host has no test, and the AC1 'one command' hint wording.
